name: vibespace
description: VibeSpace — a backend-agnostic web workspace for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, …) with a multi-session tiling window manager

scripts.build: node scripts/i18n-check.mjs && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('src/lib/build-version.js','// GENERATED at build (gitignored) — the bundle\'s own version, compared against /api/version on ws reconnect (stale-tab auto-reload)\nexport const BUILD_VERSION = '+JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').version)+';\n')" && esbuild src/client.js --bundle --outfile=public/bundle.js --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020 --loader:.css=css --minify && esbuild node_modules/@novnc/novnc/core/rfb.js --bundle --outfile=public/novnc.js --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify && npm run build:agentd && node scripts/test-bundle-globals.mjs && node scripts/test-architecture.mjs && node scripts/test-ws-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-session-schema.mjs
scripts.build:agentd: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version;require('fs').writeFileSync('src/agentd/version.js','module.exports = { VERSION: '+JSON.stringify(v)+' };\n')" && esbuild src/agentd/agentd.js --bundle --platform=node --external:node-pty --outfile=data/bin/vibespace-agentd.js && esbuild src/agentd/attach-cli.js --bundle --platform=node --outfile=data/bin/vibespace-agentd-attach.js

agentTools._why: Tools the AGENT runs from its own shell, on its own PATH — NOT VibeSpace dependencies. agent-browser is deliberately NOT in dependencies/optionalDependencies: npm puts node_modules/.bin on PATH for `npm run`, so a local copy would be the binary our own gate measures while every agent session kept using the global one on PATH — the suite and production would silently test different builds. The floor is therefore DECLARED here and CHECKED AT RUNTIME (src/browser-profiles.js FLOOR_VERSION + src/browser-facts.js), with scripts/test-browser-profiles.mjs pinning the two to the same string.

agent-browser.whyThisFloor: 0.34.0 brought the persistent session-to-tab binding that makes several sessions on one shared profile safe; 0.35.2 the reverse-proxy origin hardening; 0.37.0 recording. Below the floor VibeSpace still isolates every session (four env vars, measured working on 0.32.0) and refuses the shared-profile half by capability, with one honest notice.
